QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] Communication Security
QuestInfo.0: Mayor Icebyrd Slimm drops you a line, saying there's something he needs to tell you. You should go see what he has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Mayor Icebyrd Slimm drops you a line, saying there's something he needs to tell you. You should go see what he has to say.
QuestInfo.2: Icebyrd Slimm said Subani was involved in the building of NLC--a fact he asked you to keep secret, along with all you've learned during your time researching Masteria. After all, it wouldn't do to unsettle the populace of the city.
